text: 你们在北汉尼纳河边的第一个夜晚平安度过。现在，你必须决定，是加快进度，深入这片地区；还是放慢脚步，边走边探索。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 5
text: Your first night along the North Hanninah passes without mishap. You must now decide whether to press on hard to penetrate deep into the region or set a more leisurely pace, exploring as you go.
